Title: Getting Started with ASP.NET Core
Content:
ASP.NET Core is a modern, cross-platform framework for building web applications. In this post, we'll explore the basics of ASP.NET Core and how to create your first application.

ASP.NET Core provides a powerful foundation for building scalable web applications with built-in dependency injection, logging, and middleware support.
ShortDescription: Learn the fundamentals of ASP.NET Core and start building modern web applications.

Title: Understanding Dependency Injection
Content: Dependency Injection is a fundamental design pattern that helps write maintainable and testable code. This article explores how dependency injection works and why you should use it in your applications.
